scope: Full rebuild review after Stage 4 RA-comment re-extraction: all 6 chapter files, cross-checked against cited facts and ra-comments.txt
notes: Clear structure, numbered steps and a full 10-attack string table. Friendliness is held back by 20 'Unable to verify' notes and by several honestly reported community conflicts (6-hit in Arcade vs 2P, 10-hit trigger reliability, emulator differences), which a first-time player must weigh themselves.

issues.description: Previous build recommended SwanStation, which no source mentions. Removed; emulator notes now cite DuckStation/Beetle PSX/PCSX ReArmed reports from ra-comments.
Previous build claimed an Ultra Hard run also satisfies Hand-to-Hand Veteran; ra-comments-76-4 reports doing both at once did not unlock. Now two separate runs.

Galaga rule updated: one continue for the entire run after the logic change (older unlimited-continue tips flagged as outdated), double ship only via the 18.5 s stage 1 clear, controller-2 trick does not count.

Previous build said 6-hit combos could be done in VS Mode and that character Arcade runs need default settings; corrected to Arcade mode (with conflicting 2P reports noted) and Medium-or-higher without character change (Hard, 1 round recommended).

'Defeat Galaga with a minimum of one continue' (gf1 wording) contradicted the at-most-one rule; reworded with gf3-1-2. Removed unsupported claim that All Fighters Ready for Combat! requires Devil Kazuya (ra-comments-12-3 says he is not needed for any other achievement).

Checkpoints used inconsistent categories, a 470-point total (set is 585), double-counted Heihachi, and showed 1/4 trials before Chapter 5. Standardized on the roadmap's roster / arcade clears / combos / trials with correct cumulative values.
Removed unsourced 1995 release year; split a Long Journey sentence that attributed two different players' reports to one person.
Wang, Lee, Anna and Armor King Arcade sections are thin: collected sources have few character-specific tactics for them beyond their 10-attack strings and general tips.
No collected source gives Heihachi's Arcade ladder order or boss tactics; the chapter says so rather than inventing them.

Heihachi unlock requirements genuinely conflict across sources (no continues / no lost round / under 5:30 / normal character); presented as a list with a 'safest plan'. Cannot be resolved from collected sources.
